candidates.name: Tushar Jain
candidates.headline: AI / Backend Engineer · Pixis AI
candidates.summary: AI engineer with 3+ years building production RAG systems and fintech infrastructure across early-stage startups. Founding engineer background, strong ownership signals, BITS Pilani CS + ACM ICPC Asia Regionalist.
candidates.narrative: Backend and AI engineer with three years of experience building production RAG systems, agentic workflows, and financial infrastructure across early-stage and growth startups. Started at Amazon AWS and InMobi, then made a deliberate move to Senu as the founding engineer — shipping a satellite imagery tool and executing a full healthcare pivot in under six weeks. At Dexif, led backend for a bond trading platform handling INR 5,000+ Cr in annual transactions and automated KYC for 200,000+ clients. Now at Pixis AI, building PRISM's AI layer — scoped RAG, prompt libraries, and campaign intelligence serving 50+ enterprise brands. Technically deep in LLM infrastructure: demonstrates retrieval discipline (RRF, reflection loops, grounding without citation), production data hygiene, and end-to-end ownership from design to deployment. ACM ICPC Asia Regionalist (AIR 97) and KVPY Fellow signal foundational problem-solving ability. Optimizes for ownership and complexity of the problem over title or stability — a consistent thread across every career move.

Previously built a bond trading platform at Dexif, was Founding Engineer at Senu, and interned at Amazon AWS. ACM ICPC Asia Regionalist (AIR 97).
